book.name: Eksadas
book.title: Eksadas Wen Detlot Isreil Pipul Bin Libum Ijip

content: Mosis bin bon
Wal det taim na wen det adwan lowa blanga det Ijip king bin stil on, wan Isreil men brom det klen gulum Libai bin merrit langa wan gel brom det seimwan klen,
en det gel bin abum boiwan beibi, en wen im mami bin luk det beibi bin brabli gudwan, imbin blandim im blanga thrimants brom det king.

Bat det beibi bin gro, en im mami bin sabi im kaan kipgon blandimbat im langa im kemp. Wal det gel bin lafta gajim baskit, en imbin rabum det baskit garram bitjaman wulijim woda kaan gowin, en imbin pudum det beibi insaid langa det baskit, en imbin pudum lid ontop langa det baskit, en imbin deigim det baskit garram det beibi, en imbin pudum im langa ola longwan gras wansaid langa det riba,
en det sista blanga det beibi bin jandap lilbit longwei blanga wotjimbat im.

Bambai na det doda blanga det king bin godan langa det riba blanga bogi garram ola wekingel blanga im, en wen detlot wekingel bin wok wansaid langa det riba, det king doda bin luk det baskit deya insaid langa detlot longwan gras, en imbin dalim wan wekingel blanga gajim det baskit,

en det wekingel bin gajim det baskit, en wen det king doda bin deigimat det lidpat, imbin luk det beibi insaid, en wen imbin luk det beibi kraikrai, imbin sori blanga im, en imbin tok, “Dijan beibi blanga Isreil gel.”
Wal det sista blanga det beibi bin go langa det king doda, en imbin askim im, “Yu wandim mi blanga go en gajim Isreil gel blanga lukaftumbat det beibi en gibit im milk?”
Wal det king doda bin tok, “Yuwai.” En det sista blanga det beibi bin go, en imbin gajim dubala ron mami,

en wen det beibi mami bin kaman deya, det king doda bin dalim im, “Yu deigim dis beibi, en yu lukaftum im blanga mi, en ai garra peiyim yu.” En det Isreil gel bin deigim det beibi, en imbin lukaftumbat im.

Afta wen det beibi bin gro bigwan, det Isreil gel bin deigim im langa det king doda, en det king doda bin meigim det lilboi jidan ronwan san blanga im, en det king doda bin tok, “Ai garra gulum im neim Mosis, dumaji aibin pulumat im brom det woda.”
Mosis bin ranawei

Bambai na wen Mosis bin big men, imbin wandi go en luk hau im ron pipul olabat bin oldei jidan, en wen imbin go, imbin luk ol detlot Ijip pipul bin oldei fosimbat detlot Isreil pipul blanga dumbat olkain adwek blanga olabat. En imbin luk wan Ijip men bin beldimbat wan Isreil men.

Wal Mosis bin sori blanga im kantrimen, en imbin lukaran if enibodi bin lukinat im, en wen nobodi bin lukinat im, imbin kilim det men hubin beldimbat im kantrimen, en imbin berrim det bodi langa sengraun.
Neksdei na Mosis bin gobek langa det seim pleis, en imbin luk dubala Isreil men bin faidabat, en imbin askim wanbala, “Wotfo yu beldimbat yu ron kantrimen?”

Wal det men bin tok, “Hubin meigim yu bos blanga kotim melabat? Maitbi yu garra kilim mi ded seimwei laik yubin kilim det men brom dijan kantri?” Wal wen det men bin tok lagijat, Mosis bin bradin, en imbin jinggabat na. Imbin tok, “Maitbi ola pipul sabi wanim aibin dum.”

Wal wen det king bin gedim det bednyus, imbin wandi kilim Mosis. Bat Mosis bin ranawei langa det longwei kantri gulum Midiyan, en wen imbin kamat langa det kantri, imbin jidan deya wansaid langa wan wel.

Wal wan serramonimen neim Jethro bin deya langa det kantri, en imbin abum sebenbala doda, en detlot doda blanga im bin oldei lukaftumbat ola gout en ship blanga im. Wal detlot gel bin kaman deya langa det wel weya Mosis bin jidan blanga gibit woda langa ol detlot gout en ship.

Bat sambala stakmen deya bin andimwei olabat brom det wel. Wal wen Mosis bin luk detlot stakmen bin andimwei detlot gel, imbin go en album detlot gel, en imbin gibit woda langa ola gout en ship blanga olabat.
Afta na detlot gel bin gobek langa olabat dedi, en imbin askim olabat, “Wotfo yumob bin kambek kwikbala?”
En detlot gel bin tok, “Detlot stakmen bin andimwei melabat brom det wel. Bat wan men brom Ijip bin album melabat, en imbin gibit woda langa ola gout en ship blanga melabat.”
Wal olabat dedi bin tok, “Wal weya im? Wotfo yumob bin libum im deya? Yumob go en askim im blanga kaman en dagat daga iya garram wi.”
Wal deibin go en gajim Mosis, en deibin askim im blanga stap garram olabat, en imbin duwit langa olabat. Wal det olmen Jethro bin gibit im doda neim Sipora langa Mosis, en dubala bin merrit,
en bambai det gel bin abum boiwan beibi, en Mosis bin tok, “Wal ai garra gulum im neim Gesham, dumaji mi streinja langa dijan kantri.”
God bin pikimat Mosis

Bambai na longtaim afta wen Mosis bin ranawei brom Ijip, det king blanga det kantri bin dai. Bat detlot Ijip pipul bin stil fosim detlot Isreil pipul blanga jidan jis laiga prisana en dumbat ola adwek, en detlot Isreil pipul bin oldei askimbat God blanga album olabat.
Wal God bin irrim detlot Isreil pipul jinginat langa im, en imbin jinggabat det strongwan pramis weya imbin meigim garram Eibrahem, Aisik en Jeikob basdam.
En imbin luk hau detlot Isreil pipul bin oldei jidan jis laiga prisana, en imbin jinggabat langa olabat.
